purpose: Teach: いきさつ/参列/次女/釧路/憂慮/を以て/綴り/かんがみ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯人逮捕までのいきさつを、警察、丁寧に説明されますね
lines.en: So the police explained the circumstances leading up to the suspect's arrest in detail, didn't they?
lines.style: Measured, observant tone. Soft emphasis on 'so'—acknowledging what's been said. Pace is deliberate but not slow. Slight upward lift at the end, genuinely curious about the answer.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者葬儀への参列もされますね
lines.en: The police also attended the victim's funeral, I understand.
lines.style: Professional but warm acknowledgment. Steady pace, matter-of-fact. A light nod in the voice—confirming something already understood. No performance, just presence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の次女からの証言を、警察、取られますね
lines.en: And the police took testimony from the victim's second daughter, I believe?
lines.style: Thoughtful, methodical. Slightly slower pace on the middle phrase. Genuine question—not testing, just seeking confirmation. Soft upward inflection at the close.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、釧路署との合同捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police also conducted a joint investigation with the Kushiro precinct, correct?
lines.style: Clear, professional. Even pacing. Steady eye-contact in the voice. A simple factual confirmation—collaborative in tone, not pushing back.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、社会への影響に憂慮を、警察、表明されますね
lines.en: The police expressed concern about the impact this case will have on society, didn't they?
lines.style: Gentle but serious. Slight pause before 'concern'—weighing the gravity. Quieter delivery on that phrase. Pace steady and respectful. Real acknowledgment of the weight being carried.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、書面を以て上層部に報告されますね
lines.en: The police reported the findings to upper management in written form, I believe?
lines.style: Procedural and precise. Even tone, steady pace. Professional formality—not stiff, just following the proper channels. Slight finality at the close.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の供述の綴りを、警察、精査されますね
lines.en: The police carefully reviewed the suspect's statement for accuracy and detail, yes?
lines.style: Thorough and attentive. Slight emphasis on 'carefully'—acknowledging the diligence required. Measured pace. Genuinely interested in the meticulousness of the process.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、過去の判例にかんがみて立件されますね
lines.en: The police filed charges in light of precedent cases, didn't they?
lines.style: Grounded, experienced tone. Slower on 'precedent cases'—showing respect for the legal framework. Steady, confident. Not questioning, just confirming the proper procedure was followed.
